skill_name: Write a letter to your local senator expressing your opinion on gun control laws.
workflow:
Dear Senator [name], 

I am writing to express my opinion on gun control laws. I believe that gun control laws should be enacted to reduce the amount of gun violence and protect citizens from the dangers of guns. Individuals should be subject to background checks to ensure that they are not a risk to public safety before being allowed to purchase a firearm.
